setting.readOnly.description: Block every statement that writes to the database.
setting.confirmDestructiveQueries.descri: Ask for confirmation before DROP, TRUNCATE, ALTER and DELETE/UPDATE without WHERE.
setting.maxRows.description: Maximum number of rows shown in the results panel.
setting.dockerHost.description: Docker Engine endpoint, set only in user settings. Leave empty to use DOCKER_HOST or the platform default (unix socket or Windows named pipe). A tcp:// endpoint is not encrypted and carries the credentials of the containers.
setting.ai.provider.description: Which AI provider powers the AI features.
setting.ai.provider.enum.vscode: Language models available in VS Code (for example GitHub Copilot). No API key needed.
setting.ai.provider.enum.anthropic: Anthropic API with your own key.
setting.ai.provider.enum.openai: OpenAI API with your own key.
setting.ai.model.description: Model id for the selected provider. Leave empty to use the provider default.
setting.ai.ollamaUrl.description: Base URL of the Ollama server.
setting.mcp.enabled.description: Expose discovered databases to AI agents through an MCP server that only accepts reads. Off by default. Connect with a database user that has limited permissions, because agents see the data they read.
setting.codeLens.enabled.description: Show the database of the file and Run and Explain actions above each statement in SQL files.
setting.history.maxEntries.description: How many executed queries to keep in the history. Use 0 to turn the history off.
setting.connections.markdownDescription: Saved database connections. Manage them with the **Add New Connection** command. Passwords are stored in the operating system keychain, never here.
setting.table.pageSize.description: How many rows the table editor reads per page.
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces.descrip: A repository can define settings used to reach databases, so the extension only runs in trusted workspaces.
capabilities.virtualWorkspaces.descripti: The extension needs local access to Docker, SSH and files.
